title: Refined size bound for binarization
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose each gate has pairwise distinct arguments and every negation gate has exactly one argument. The size of the binarized circuit is at most $n+\sum_{g\in G}\max\{1,\ell(g)-1\}$, where $G$ is the gate list and $\ell(g)$ is the number of arguments of gate $g$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Each gate has pairwise distinct arguments
Each negation gate has exactly one argument
